s: File → Save as → Power BI Project (.pbip). Check the project folder: <name>.SemanticModel/definition/*.tmdl and <name>.Report/definition/ (PBIR). If you see report.json instead of a definition folder, your Desktop build is older than September 2026: update it.
Run the git commands below in the project folder.
Edit a measure in Desktop → save → git diff. Then edit the same measure in the .tmdl file in VS Code and save: Desktop shows "Apply external changes". Apply, and the model updates without reopening.
Fabric workspace → Workspace settings → Git integration → connect repo/branch → Commit/Update.
